status: selected optimization and usable checked-B1 release qualified; portable evidence complete
scope: Compact portable results for selected typed-build10. Repository-relative paths identify retained local artifacts; raw build artifacts are not implied to be tracked. SHA256 pins join these results to exact local evidence. No pooled full-language conformance denominator and no universal program-speed parity claim.

nativeProgramRuntime.compilerStage: B1 emitted C, compiled by pinned Clang; not B2 compiler execution time

method.runtimeScope: Same wrapper, 16-input cycle, fixed warmups and measured repetitions per role. Four stdout lines: base, warm digest, measured digest, integer milliseconds. Execution excludes imports and C build; checksum formatting/printing included.
method.timingScope: Fresh uninstrumented saved-binary execution. Excludes Bend emission and C build. Historical compiler23/upstream emission provenance retained; fresh candidate acquisition. Three samples per family/role, descriptive medians without confidence-interval claim.

nativeProgramRuntime.limitation: The aggregate is near parity on these six fixed-work families; closures are much faster than upstream while tree/map/lexer remain slower. This is not evidence that every program has reached parity.

nativeControls.scope: Selected probes only. Exact fixture or explicit acceptance oracles and compiler agreement are separate. Complete full-suite conformance is never inferred.
nativeControls.environment: Run with approved escalation and unchanged CPU/RSS guards after managed-sandbox Node24 spawnSync default-stdin PIPE produced EPERM despite completed child commands. Failed earlier attempts remain retained.

rawNativeControls.scope: Raw core/control observations compare compiler23 and candidate without claiming source type acceptance. Runtime witnesses use threads1 and4 with GPU off; established diagnostics require exact first errors. Two mocked shared-error rows run on CPU and make no device-conformance claim. Forged-static refusal requires nonempty error and no emitted C, not identical unsupported-node wording. Dead/masked bang selection and static-word invariants are explicit structural oracles.

staticImageBoundaries.scope: Pure candidate helper, actual 65534/65535-word prefixes; no C/native execution or whole-emitter cap claim.

jsProtection.scope: Exact generated closure of all exported roots not starting nc_, runtime and public wrappers; no changed function permitted.
jsProtection.limitation: Structural byte protection against compiler23; not a newly timed JS benchmark or full JS conformance rerun.

genuineB2.driverScope: Exact ordinary driver observations and JS/C emitted bytes; JS result executed. C emitted only. No compiler fixed-point claim.

emissionChecking.scope: Exact subject source proof inherited; current generator still performs frontend completion and emission proofs.

genuineB2.limitation: Image generation and8 driver checks are qualified by the separate selfHostingQualification section. No invented checked-development B2 sidecar; B2 C-emission timing and exact-output evidence are in nativeCompilation.

simplicity.scope: Frozen registered Bend modules counted once, matching Phase68 physical/code-line rules. Definitions/laws/types are syntactic counts, not semantic-concept complexity. Runtime/host, generated C and diagnostic infrastructure are excluded from Bend counts. Evidence list is a point-in-time status inventory while root may still run; it is not a final qualification join, pooled denominator or performance conclusion.

timeSnapshot.scope: Interim guard-receipt accounting only. Excludes work before first target and non-target/source preparation. Not finished-phase elapsed time; an in-flight target may not have written its receipt.

nativeCompilation.scope: Fresh processes and mandatory prepared Bend Base. Imports/API loading, explicit preparation, full checked C-emission request, Clang and runtime are separate clocks. TS ordinary book_load checks Base within its request. Exact C must match independently validated native acquisitions from the separately identified oracleAttempt; fresh selected B1/B2 workers earn this complete-byte equality and no earlier producer is relabeled. Profile workers are diagnostics, never timing samples. One round is a screen; three rotations are required for a position-balanced TS/B1/B2 comparison.
nativeCompilation.limitation: Three selected source programs, three fresh-process rounds per compiler role. This measures checked C-emission request time, not generated-program execution, C build, or JS-emission parity. B1/B2 prepared Base before measured requests; upstream checks Base within request. Four optional profile jobs were intentionally omitted, so the original all-campaign analyzer remains complete:false while every clean request and preparation gate passed.

allocationDiagnostics.newTargets: candidate only; each1/17repetitions, zero warmup, threads1/GPUoff
allocationDiagnostics.scope: Exact inherited atomic operation/site instrumentation. Whole diagnostic C and independently checked historical outputs proved before cache reuse. Source-operation frequencies, not time attribution or performance timings.
allocationDiagnostics.deltaRule: Per role and case: counters at17 measured workloads minus counters at1, zero warmup, exactly16 additional varying-input workloads; never clean timing credit.

sourceTrustOracle.method: Every unique def in the exact selected checked assembly is explicitly annotated @unsafe; count is derived from that pinned source.

ownSourceCheck.scope: The actual self-emitted B2 image checks its exact complete source through a private byte-identical ordinary driver. The private Base cache starts empty. Fresh type acceptance and the explicit unsafe proof-trust failure are separate outcomes; no checked development attempt, fixed point or mathematical proof is invented.

b3Reproduction.scope: Exact emission fixed point on the explicitly pinned checked source and actual checked-export closure. No fresh compiler-source self-check, new bootstrap trust, or installation claim.

generatedArtifactAndCBuildEvidence.scope: Exact artifacts consumed by the balanced native-runtime campaign. Candidate acquisition is fresh Phase69; compiler23 and upstream sizes and Clang durations come from the original separately pinned Phase68/67 acquisitions. Clang duration is one guarded acquisition build per artifact, not a newly balanced C-compilation benchmark or clean Bend-request timing. All use inherited pinned -O3 Clang recipe.

release.scope: Promoted selected checked equality-derived B1 after independent actual-B2 self-hosting qualification. Release smoke and helper checks are separate from selected native/raw controls and do not form a full-language denominator. Historical seven-file lineage preserved byte for byte.

timeAccount.scope: Final receipt snapshot after phase owner declared target execution finished. Unique guarded jobs only; excludes work before first target and non-target/source work. Includes retained failed experiments. Guard occupancy is the union of intervals, not agent effort or quota. No whole-phase elapsed-time claim.
